LubbyC privacy policy

Last updated: 14 November 2026. Contact: collens-inc@outlook.com.

What we collect

  • Account: name, email address and user ID (required, for your account).
  • Profile (optional): birth year, country, bio, interests and profile photo.
  • What you create: plans, messages in group and event chats, reviews and photos.
  • Location (optional): only while you use the app, to show the map and places around you, and to record your travel route if you turn that on. Your exact location is never shown to other users.
  • Device ID: only to prevent abuse of the free trial.

Why

Only to make the app work: your account, creating and joining plans, chat, the map and the travel guide. We do not sell your data and we do not show ads.

Who receives it

Your data is stored with our database provider Supabase (processor). When you look up places nearby, your location is sent at that moment to public map services (OpenFreeMap, Overpass) to fetch those places. Other users only see what you share in your profile and plans; basic members see fewer profile details than Premium members.

Storage and deletion

Data is encrypted in transit. You can delete your account and data in the app or by emailing collens-inc@outlook.com.

Age

LubbyC is for adults only (18+).

Your rights

You can request access, correction or deletion via the email address above, and you can file a complaint with your data protection authority (in the Netherlands: the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).
